		📋 Dataset Structure
	

The dataset structure is as follows:
Kling-Audio-Eval
├── Folder (first-level label)
│   ├── Folder (second-level label)            
│   │   ├── video    
│   │   │   └── *.mp4               
│   │   ├── audio
│   │   │   └── *.wav    
│   │   └── caption.csv                 # Header: video, audio, audio_tag, video_caption, audio_caption… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/klingfoley/Kling-Audio-Eval.
